# `incomplete-assignment`: Incomplete combinational assignment / 组合逻辑赋值不完整

**Severity / 严重程度:** `warning`

## English

### Cause

A combinational process leaves the output unassigned on at least one control-flow path.

### Risk

The retained previous value implies a latch, changing timing and behavior from pure combinational logic.

### Fix

Assign a default before the branch or assign the output in every branch.

## 简体中文

### 原因

组合过程至少有一条控制路径没有给输出赋值。

### 风险

输出会保留旧值并推断锁存器，使时序和功能偏离预期的组合逻辑。

### 修复

在分支前设置默认值，或确保每一条分支都明确给输出赋值。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module incomplete_assignment(input logic enable, input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  always_comb if (enable) data_o = data_i;
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module incomplete_assignment(input logic enable, input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  always_comb begin
    data_o = 1'b0;
    if (enable) data_o = data_i;
  end
endmodule
```
